name: semmem
description: Private human-readable memory with revision history and staged text retrieval.

interface.longDescription: Search and maintain human-readable memories on your WSL2 machine through a private OpenAI Secure MCP Tunnel. Supports summaries, scopes, provenance, versioned corrections, history, recoverable deletion, and restoration.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Semmem to recall relevant saved context for this task.
